paragraphs.text: Enchanting Tales is a non- Standard set of cards associated with Wilds of Eldraine .

Enchanting Tales is a separate set of cards associated with Wilds of Eldraine , similar to the Retro Artifacts and Multiverse Legends bonus sheets . In Enchanting Tales , Wizards of the Coast have reprinted 63 enchantments (18 uncommons, 30 rares, 15 mythic rares) with a special card frame and the set code WOT. These will only be legal in formats that they are already legal in and in Historic . They are not part of the Standard environment, however the cards may be used in Limited events. Those cards are part of your card pool in a Sealed Deck tournament. In a Booster Draft tournament, you must draft those cards for them to be included in your card pool.
Out of the 63 Enchanting Tales cards, 20 (5 rares, 15 mythic rares) have anime borderless Booster Fun treatments illustrated by Japanese artists (#064-083).

The Enchanting Tales will be available in Wilds of Eldraine drafts on Magic: The Gathering Arena and will be legal in the Historic and Historic Brawl formats. Blood Moon , Intruder Alarm , Land Tax , Necropotence , Sneak Attack and Spreading Seas were preemptively banned from Historic but are legal in Historic Brawl.

You receive one copy — from its dedicated slot — in each Draft Booster , Set Booster , and Collector Booster . As Enchanting Tales cards are a bonus card in each booster, they don't replace another card of the same rarity in a pack.

Anime borderless cards are in the same slot as other Enchanting Tales cards in some Wilds of Eldraine boosters. Japanese boosters will have Japanese-language versions of these cards, while other languages will have English-language versions. Also, in Wilds of Eldraine Collector Boosters, confetti foil versions of these anime borderless cards can be found (#084-103).
